name: AI Automation & Chatbots
headline: Let intelligent workflows handle the repetitive work.
intro: Conversational assistants and automated workflows that answer customers, route requests and move data between your systems, so your team spends its time on decisions.

overview.what: AI automation combines language models, business rules and integrations to perform tasks end to end: answering questions, qualifying leads, processing documents and triggering actions across your software.
overview.why: Customers expect instant answers at any hour, and teams lose hours to copying data, chasing approvals and sorting inboxes. Automation takes over predictable work while people handle exceptions and relationships.
problems: Support queues full of repeated questions that already have clear answers
Leads that go cold because nobody responded quickly or consistently
Documents, forms and emails keyed in by hand into several systems
Chatbots that frustrate users because they cannot take real action
overview.approach: We pick processes with clear rules and high volume, ground assistants in your own approved content, connect them to the systems where work happens, and keep a human handover path for anything uncertain.

deliver.d: Assistants for your website and WhatsApp that answer, collect details and book or escalate.
Staff ask questions in plain language and get answers drawn from your policies and documents.
Multi-step processes that move data, send messages and update records without manual effort.
Extraction and classification of invoices, forms and contracts into structured data.
Connections to your CRM, ERP, helpdesk, calendar and messaging tools.
Conversation review, accuracy tracking and continuous improvement after launch.

capabilities.d: Responses are based on your approved content, with sources, to reduce incorrect or invented replies.
Assistants can look up orders, create tickets, schedule meetings and update records through secure APIs.
One conversation engine across web chat, WhatsApp and other channels.
Structured questions score and route enquiries to the right person with full context.
Clear escalation rules pass the conversation, with history, to your team when needed.
Content filters, access controls and data-handling rules that fit your compliance needs.

process.d: We map candidate workflows, measure volume and effort, and rank them by value and feasibility.
Approved knowledge, example conversations and system access are gathered and cleaned.
A working assistant or workflow is tested with real examples and your team.
Connections, permissions, guardrails and escalation paths are built and reviewed.
A controlled rollout with live monitoring before wider release.
Review of conversations and outcomes guides ongoing refinement.

benefits.d: Customers get immediate responses without adding headcount.
Enquiries are acknowledged, qualified and routed in moments.
Automated data movement removes retyping mistakes.
People focus on exceptions, relationships and decisions.
Every customer receives the same approved information.

usecases.d: A bot resolves common questions and hands complex cases to an agent with context.
A WhatsApp assistant qualifies leads and books a call in your calendar.
Supplier invoices are read, validated and posted to your accounting system.
Employees ask about leave, policies and payslips and receive instant answers.

cta.h: Find the work that should not need a person.
cta.p: Describe a process that eats your team's time. We will assess whether automation fits and show you what it would look like.
